_notes: Hand-edited settings for the embedded pages. publications.json is regenerated daily from Google Scholar; this file is not touched by that job.
lab_members: names (as Google Scholar writes them) to bold in author lists.
selected_publications: exact titles to pin at the top of the publications page, in display order.
exclude_titles: exact titles to hide from the main list (abstracts, talks, theses, duplicates). Visitors can still reveal them with the toggle at the bottom of the list.

Pattern rules in the publications page also hide future conference abstracts automatically (Biophysical Journal 'NNNa' pages, 'Annual Meeting', ACS abstracts, all-caps titles, 'BPS20xx-' prefixes, theses).
